# Clinaza — Embedded Healthcare & Outpatient Patient Financing Platform

> Point-of-care patient EMI financing (₹30,000 to ₹5,00,000) and free clinic management software for dental, IVF, and surgical healthcare clinics across India.

Clinaza (https://www.clinaza.in) is India's leading embedded healthcare financing infrastructure and outpatient clinic management ecosystem. It enables doctors, fertility specialists, and clinic owners to offer instant, point-of-care medical EMIs through RBI-regulated banks and NBFC partners (including credit card EMI, debit card EMI, and cardless EMIs) while providing a 100% free clinic CRM with automated WhatsApp patient recalls and digital prescription makers.

## Core Capabilities

- **Point-of-Care Patient Financing**: Instant pre-eligibility checks in under 60 seconds directly at the clinic front desk for procedures ranging from ₹30,000 to ₹5,00,000.
- **Treatments Covered**:
  - **Dental Surgery**: Dental Implants (Single, All-on-4, All-on-6), Clear Aligners, Orthodontic Braces, Full Mouth Rehabilitation, Zirconia Crowns & Smile Makeovers.
  - **Fertility & Reproductive Medicine**: IVF cycles, ICSI, IUI, Donor packages, Embryo vitrification, and Laparoscopy.
  - **Elective Healthcare**: Ophthalmology (LASIK, Cataract), Dermatology/Cosmetology (Hair transplants, laser treatments), and Day-care surgical procedures.
- **100% Free Clinic CRM**: Comprehensive clinic practice portal with patient timeline history, digital prescriptions, billing, FDI tooth charting, and automated procedure tracking.
- **Automated WhatsApp Recalls & Campaigns**: 1-click patient reactivation for hygiene checkups, pending treatment plans, and post-procedure check-ins.
- **Multi-Lender Network**: Connected with 13+ RBI-regulated NBFCs and payment gateways (PayU, PhonePe, Easycred) to maximize approval rates across Tier-1, Tier-2, and Tier-3 Indian cities with direct clinic current account settlements.

## Geographic Coverage

Clinaza operates across 95+ cities in India including:
- **Tier 1**: Mumbai, Delhi NCR (New Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida, Ghaziabad), Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad, Chennai, Kolkata, Pune
- **Tier 2 & 3**: Patna, Lucknow, Jaipur, Chandigarh, Ludhiana, Indore, Bhopal, Nagpur, Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot, Kochi, Coimbatore, Madurai, Varanasi, Prayagraj, Ranchi, Bhubaneswar, Guwahati, Siliguri, Raipur, and more.

## Business Context & Target Audience

- **Healthcare Providers**: Dental surgeons, orthodontists, IVF centres, cosmetic dermatologists, and day-care clinics looking to eliminate patient drop-offs on high-ticket treatments.
- **Patients**: Individuals seeking affordable, transparent monthly EMI payment options without credit cards (Cardless EMI) or high upfront cash requirements.
